newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Easier European feeds start quietly.
newsitem.headline: Easier European feeds start quietly.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained quietly this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets $7 to $3 lower following last night's sharply lower Chicago soycomplex futures close, dealers said.
Most other products were offered unchanged to $2 lower in symapthy with soymeal.
Despite the weaker prices and an easier dollar no trades were reported during the early stages of the market.
"There is still a general lack of faith in the market. There might be some business later if Chicago futures would be called firmer," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
